title: Yehoshua, brother of Dorai
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mentioned in Jerusalem Talmud Moed Katan, chapter 3, halakhah 5, when he was in mourning and came to ask R' Abbahu a question.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The source spelling יושוע is conventionally rendered Yehoshua without changing Hebrew. Initial dalet in דדוריי is of, giving Dorai rather than Dedorai. The brother and mourning relations remain source assertions.
מו״ק פ״ג ה״ה explicitly gives Jerusalem Talmud Moed Katan chapter 3 halakhah 5, without independent named-edition verification. Yehoshua comes to ask Abbahu; the latter’s title remains R'.
